description.value: Mr. India Restaurant & Bar is an Indian restaurant in Abbotsford serving cuisine inspired by regions across the subcontinent, from street snacks like golgappa and vada paav to full curry entrées and cocktails. The restaurant offers both a dine-in bar experience and a robust takeout and catering operation, including tiffin service and large-group party packs. With over 600 Google reviews and more than 30 vegetarian and non-vegetarian entrées, it is a well-established local dining destination.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 79m; rack (3 spaces) at 93m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (mrindiaeats.com) loaded successfully and is the primary evidence source. It consistently presents the business as 'Mr. India Restaurant & Bar' located in Abbotsford — not 'Mr India Meats & Restaurant' in Chilliwack as OSM records. The phone number also differs: OSM has +1-604-870-4892 while the website shows 604.870.4898 on every page; the website value is used as it appears repeatedly and authoritatively. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill was found anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Mr India Meats & Restaurant' (with 'shop=butcher' tag) but the website presents exclusively as 'Mr. India Restaurant & Bar' with no mention of a butcher or meat shop.
Phone number discrepancy: OSM has +1-604-870-4892 but website consistently shows 604.870.4898 (last digit differs). Website value used.

Community/city mismatch: OSM community tag is 'Chilliwack' but website repeatedly states the business is 'Located in Abbotsford' and 'The Taste Of India In Abbotsford BC'. Coordinates are consistent with Abbotsford, not Chilliwack.
No street address available in OSM or on the website content fetched; OSM only provides addr:unit=17.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Multiple data quality issues require human verification before listing: OSM community says Chilliwack but the website and coordinates (~49.048°N, 122.339°W) point to Abbotsford; the business name differs between OSM and the website; and the phone number last digit differs. Once corrected, the business would be a reasonable Food & Drink listing for touring cyclists given its takeout options and vegetarian menu.
